# ui::AutomationEvents

Header: `winui/ui/AutomationTree.hpp`.

Receives what changed in a [Window](window.md), for accessibility clients. The platform passes these changes on to screen readers, and a test can record them (ui::testing::seams(window)).

The window reports after each layout, which follows every input it handles, in this order:
1. menus that opened or closed, and the nodes whose children changed with them
1. the node [automation_focus()](namespace-ui.md#automation_focus) names: a new one as focused, or the same one's changed properties
1. a change among the items around it (added, removed or renamed)

## ~AutomationEvents

```cpp
virtual ~AutomationEvents() = default
```

## listening

```cpp
virtual bool listening() const = 0
```

Whether a client is listening; while false the window skips the checks.

## property_changed

```cpp
virtual void property_changed(Element& node, AutomationProperty property, const AutomationValue& before, const AutomationValue& after) = 0
```

`property` of `node`, the node with automation focus, went from `before` to `after`.

